scope: One additional no-account public A2A directory for the existing councilof.ai agent card
reason: Five credible directories already carry CSOAI; a sixth has two duplicate CSOAI entries. The one remaining candidate, AgentFolio, requires screenshot proof and a 24-48 hour manual review, and its homepage showed zero agents in the public readback. No instant independently verifiable listing was available there.

candidate_checked.listing_requirements: Public agent-card URL, screenshot proof of stats, and manual 24-48 hour review
candidate_checked.decision: Do not submit unproven stats or count an unreviewed submission as a public listing

correction_opportunity: Wellknown has two public CSOAI records. Reconcile/claim rather than create a third; preserve the valid measurement-only description.
claim_limit: Listings evidence discoverability only, not usage, adoption, endorsement, or revenue.
